newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Megionneftegaz '96 oil output slips.
newsitem.headline: Russian Megionneftegaz '96 oil output slips.

text.p: Russia's Megionneftegaz saw its 1996 crude oil output slip to 12.47 million tonnes from 12.84 million in 1995, the company said in a statement on Monday.
It forecast oil output in 1997 further slipping to 11.94 million tonnes.
Megionneftegaz is the Russia-based production unit of Russian-Belarussian joint venture NGK Slavneft. The vertically-integrated oil company is 80 percent owned by the Russian government.
The unit's production of gas condensate last year was 749 million cubic metres (mcm) above 1995's 743 mcm. Gas condensate output for 1997 was targeted at 670 mcm.
The company gave no output details for Slavneft's refineries.
Megionneftegaz, also known as OAO Slavneft-Megionneftegaz, said last month that it planned to issue American Depositary Receipts, or ADRs, in the first quarter of this year.
